description: A Custom API, its request parameters and response properties. Leave a property out to keep it. Parameters and properties left out are kept.

solution.description: Unique name of the unmanaged solution the API goes into. Its publisher decides the prefix.

uniqueName.description: The message name, with the publisher prefix, for example con_CloseProject. Cannot change.

binding.description: Default global. Changing it recreates the API.

boundTable.description: Table logical name, for binding entity or entityCollection. Changing it recreates the API.

isFunction.description: A function (GET in the Web API) instead of an action. Default false. Changing it recreates the API.

stepType.description: Which plug-in steps others may register on the message. Default none. Changing it recreates the API.

workflowEnabled.description: Usable as a classic workflow step. Default false. Changing it recreates the API.

executePrivilege.description: Name of a privilege a caller needs, for example prvReadcon_project.

pluginType.description: Full type name of the registered plug-in type that runs the API. Deploy it with plugin_deploy first.

items.description: A request parameter or response property. uniqueName, type, table and optional cannot change: changing one recreates it.

uniqueName.description: The name callers use, for example Reason.

table.description: Table logical name, for entity and entityReference.
